"""Send one operation to the local work-order desk."""

import json
import sys
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path


def main() -> None:
    mailbox = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / ".desk"
    message = mailbox / uuid.uuid4().hex
    pending = message.with_suffix(".pending")
    pending.write_text(json.dumps(sys.argv[1:]), encoding="utf-8")
    pending.rename(message.with_suffix(".request"))
    answer = message.with_suffix(".reply")
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
    while not answer.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.05)
    if not answer.exists():
        raise SystemExit("The local desk did not respond.")
    print(answer.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
